tools.name: tender_match
tools.description: FREE. Live open UK public-sector tenders (Contracts Finder) matching your keywords and optional region — top 3 newest.

tools.name: tender_match_full
tools.description: PRO. All open matches (up to 100) for a saved profile: several keyword sets + regions, with values, deadlines and days left. Optional min_value filter.

tools.name: new_since
tools.description: PRO. Daily check: only tenders published since a date (default last 24h) for your keyword profile.

tools.name: closing_soon
tools.description: PRO. Matches with deadlines in the next N days (default 14), soonest first.
